run.name: American Airlines, Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session
run.summary: American is highly leveraged and its earnings are thin, so its credit rests on liquidity and asset-backed funding. The outcome turns on fuel, access to financing for aircraft commitments, and parent support. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is AMERICAN AIRLINES, INC..

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. American only. Debt and finance leases 25,876 over LTM EBITDA 2,916 (FY2025 plus nine months 2026 less nine months 2025); net of 8,253. Cash includes pre-funding from new debt. Excludes operating leases and pensions.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. American only. LTM EBITDA 2,916 over LTM interest paid, net 1,416 (1,551 plus 1,044 less 1,179); same limitation.

cash.basis: Cash. American only. Cash 1,094 plus short-term investments 7,159. 50 of the facilities expires December 2026; letters of credit at this date not printed.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Debt documents, ratings and post-quarter information are not supplied, and EBITDA and ratios are derived, not reported.
CP-1 main limitation: Covenant levels, executed debt terms and interim letters of credit are not supplied; EBITDA is derived, not reported.
